''See also: [[Reader (The Elder Empire: Shadow) Timeline]]''

== Overview ==
{{spoiler|book=ee-shadow-03-of-killers-and-kings|A Reader is a practitioner of a discipline centered on the sensing and manipulation of human [[Intent]]. This ability allows them to perceive various layers of reality, ranging from the minute history and details embedded in physical objects to the broader currents of [[Intent]] flowing through entire cities, armies, or landscapes. Beyond mere perception, skilled [[Readers]] can actively influence the world by using their [[Intent]] to cause physical changes in objects, such as altering their shape or composition. While some use these talents for investigative purposes—such as uncovering secrets or detecting lies—others utilize them for combat, the creation of weapons, or subtle environmental manipulation. The power of a Reader is often tied to their level of skill and focus rather than physical strength, requiring an understanding more akin to that of a poet. Highly proficient individuals can exist almost entirely outside the reach of traditional law, as they possess the capability to bypass physical restraints and evade standard judicial enforcement. However, the discipline carries significant risks; attempting to directly examine the [[Intent]] of an Elder is a major taboo that can result in insanity due to the alien nature of those minds. Within the hierarchy of [[The Empire|the Empire]], the Emperor stands as an unparalleled Reader, possessing a level of mastery and a vast network of subordinates that allows him to predict and counter threats on a global [[scale]].}}

== Relationships ==
{{spoiler|book=ee-shadow-03-of-killers-and-kings|[[Lucan]] is a member of the group known as [[Readers]]. [[Loreli]] utilizes her specific awareness to sense through [[water]], and a Reader was noted to be searching for her nearby. [[Shera]] targets a Reader with her blade, though she herself is not one. [[Nakothi's song]] can be felt directly by a [[Reader’s senses|Reader's senses]].}}

== History ==
=== {{spoiler|book=ee-shadow-01-of-shadow-and-sea|Of Shadow and Sea}} ===
{{spoiler|book=ee-shadow-01-of-shadow-and-sea|[[Readers]] are a specific type of individual, some of whom possess the ability to lay curses for hire.<ref name="ee-shadow-01-of-shadow-and-sea-c1">''Of Shadow and Sea'', chapter 1</ref> By definition, [[Chroniclers]] are considered talented [[Readers]], and the discipline itself involves sensing and manipulating human [[Intent]].<ref name="ee-shadow-01-of-shadow-and-sea-c4">''Of Shadow and Sea'', chapter 4</ref><ref name="ee-shadow-01-of-shadow-and-sea-c14">''Of Shadow and Sea'', chapter 14</ref> Through the ability to [[Awaken]] an object, [[Readers]] can consciously observe and manipulate the [[Intent]] stored within it.<ref name="ee-shadow-01-of-shadow-and-sea-c6">''Of Shadow and Sea'', chapter 6</ref><ref name="ee-shadow-01-of-shadow-and-sea-c19">''Of Shadow and Sea'', chapter 19</ref> These individuals utilize specialized [[Reader senses]] to determine information through touch, though bringing out an object's full potential requires significant strength and focus.<ref name="ee-shadow-01-of-shadow-and-sea-c7">''Of Shadow and Sea'', chapter 7</ref><ref name="ee-shadow-01-of-shadow-and-sea-c11">''Of Shadow and Sea'', chapter 11</ref> They excel at tasks such as investigating crimes, crafting tools or weapons, enacting subtle sabotage, and manipulating information received by other [[Readers]].<ref name="ee-shadow-01-of-shadow-and-sea-c6" /> A Reader can directly feel the power of [[Nakothi's song]] with their senses.<ref name="ee-shadow-01-of-shadow-and-sea-c15">''Of Shadow and Sea'', chapter 15</ref>}}

=== {{spoiler|book=ee-shadow-02-of-darkness-and-dawn|Of Darkness and Dawn}} ===
{{spoiler|book=ee-shadow-02-of-darkness-and-dawn|[[Readers]] are individuals possessing specific powers that [[Shera]] can target with her blade, making them far more powerful than the prisoners she previously killed.<ref name="ee-shadow-02-of-darkness-and-dawn-c2">''Of Darkness and Dawn'', chapter 2</ref> While they have very little [[Intent]] to manipulate, these individuals can pick up on strong emotions and visions through stored [[Intent]].<ref name="ee-shadow-02-of-darkness-and-dawn-c3">''Of Darkness and Dawn'', chapter 3</ref><ref name="ee-shadow-02-of-darkness-and-dawn-c4">''Of Darkness and Dawn'', chapter 4</ref> Subject to specific rules regarding their abilities, [[Readers]] are a group capable of influencing the course of weapons.<ref name="ee-shadow-02-of-darkness-and-dawn-c7">''Of Darkness and Dawn'', chapter 7</ref><ref name="ee-shadow-02-of-darkness-and-dawn-c11">''Of Darkness and Dawn'', chapter 11</ref> Despite possessing certain advantages and sensitivities, they often complain that their [[Reading]] lacks detail.<ref name="ee-shadow-02-of-darkness-and-dawn-c14">''Of Darkness and Dawn'', chapter 14</ref><ref name="ee-shadow-02-of-darkness-and-dawn-c18">''Of Darkness and Dawn'', chapter 18</ref> One of the [[Architects]] is a Reader, and [[Shera]]'s current target is also one.<ref name="ee-shadow-02-of-darkness-and-dawn-c19">''Of Darkness and Dawn'', chapter 19</ref> The state of being a Reader causes the mind to expand and swirl upon the mists, though such an individual would be unable to uncover Rudeus's connection to the [[Consultants]] once his blacks are burned.<ref name="ee-shadow-02-of-darkness-and-dawn-c21">''Of Darkness and Dawn'', chapter 21</ref><ref name="ee-shadow-02-of-darkness-and-dawn-c22">''Of Darkness and Dawn'', chapter 22</ref>}}
<div class="wv-facts mw-collapsible mw-collapsed"><div class="wv-facts-head mw-collapsible-toggle">Sourced facts <span class="wv-facts-count">13</span></div>
<ul class="wv-fact-list mw-collapsible-content">
